```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 12,
  fig.height = 7,
  dpi = 160
)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

set.seed(1031)
```

## 设计说明

本例复现参考图中的三阶段分类冲积图结构。数据全部为可重复生成的模拟数据：左侧为国家，中间为 LFP 类别，右侧为生态区域；流带颜色表示 LFP score。纵轴表示每条流带占全部观测的比例。

## 生成模拟数据

```{r simulate-data}
countries <- c("NZL", "AUS", "ARG", "MEX", "FRA", "CHL", "USA", "GBR")
country_probability <- c(0.025, 0.035, 0.060, 0.075, 0.105, 0.180, 0.225, 0.295)

lfp_profiles <- list(
  NZL = c(None = 0.10, Less = 0.16, Moderately = 0.24, Highly = 0.50),
  AUS = c(None = 0.12, Less = 0.20, Moderately = 0.30, Highly = 0.38),
  ARG = c(None = 0.22, Less = 0.29, Moderately = 0.30, Highly = 0.19),
  MEX = c(None = 0.28, Less = 0.35, Moderately = 0.24, Highly = 0.13),
  FRA = c(None = 0.38, Less = 0.34, Moderately = 0.20, Highly = 0.08),
  CHL = c(None = 0.30, Less = 0.31, Moderately = 0.24, Highly = 0.15),
  USA = c(None = 0.43, Less = 0.31, Moderately = 0.18, Highly = 0.08),
  GBR = c(None = 0.51, Less = 0.29, Moderately = 0.14, Highly = 0.06)
)

realm_profiles <- list(
  NZL = c(`Southern Ocean` = 0.53, `Temperate Northern Pacific` = 0.08,
          `Temperate South America` = 0.29, `Tropical Atlantic` = 0.10),
  AUS = c(`Southern Ocean` = 0.42, `Temperate Northern Pacific` = 0.20,
          `Temperate South America` = 0.25, `Tropical Atlantic` = 0.13),
  ARG = c(`Southern Ocean` = 0.21, `Temperate Northern Pacific` = 0.06,
          `Temperate South America` = 0.61, `Tropical Atlantic` = 0.12),
  MEX = c(`Southern Ocean` = 0.03, `Temperate Northern Pacific` = 0.47,
          `Temperate South America` = 0.14, `Tropical Atlantic` = 0.36),
  FRA = c(`Southern Ocean` = 0.08, `Temperate Northern Pacific` = 0.45,
          `Temperate South America` = 0.18, `Tropical Atlantic` = 0.29),
  CHL = c(`Southern Ocean` = 0.18, `Temperate Northern Pacific` = 0.10,
          `Temperate South America` = 0.65, `Tropical Atlantic` = 0.07),
  USA = c(`Southern Ocean` = 0.03, `Temperate Northern Pacific` = 0.63,
          `Temperate South America` = 0.12, `Tropical Atlantic` = 0.22),
  GBR = c(`Southern Ocean` = 0.06, `Temperate Northern Pacific` = 0.42,
          `Temperate South America` = 0.10, `Tropical Atlantic` = 0.42)
)

score_profiles <- list(
  None = c(None = 0.76, Least = 0.11, Moderately = 0.05,
           Most = 0.03, Loss = 0.03, Heavily = 0.02),
  Less = c(None = 0.18, Least = 0.44, Moderately = 0.12,
           Most = 0.06, Loss = 0.14, Heavily = 0.06),
  Moderately = c(None = 0.06, Least = 0.14, Moderately = 0.34,
                 Most = 0.23, Loss = 0.11, Heavily = 0.12),
  Highly = c(None = 0.03, Least = 0.06, Moderately = 0.12,
             Most = 0.34, Loss = 0.15, Heavily = 0.30)
)

draw_from_profile <- function(keys, profiles) {
  vapply(
    keys,
    function(key) sample(names(profiles[[key]]), size = 1, prob = profiles[[key]]),
    character(1)
  )
}

n_observations <- 1200
country <- sample(countries, n_observations, replace = TRUE, prob = country_probability)
lfp_category <- draw_from_profile(country, lfp_profiles)
raw_data <- data.frame(country, lfp_category)

# 每条“国家—类别”路径聚合为一条流带，再为路径模拟区域和评分。
# 最多 8 × 4 = 32 条流带，使主要关系清晰且条带足够粗。
flow_data <- raw_data |>
  count(country, lfp_category, name = "n") |>
  mutate(
    realm = draw_from_profile(country, realm_profiles),
    score = draw_from_profile(lfp_category, score_profiles)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    weight = n / sum(n),
    flow_id = row_number()
  )

write.csv(
  flow_data,
  "synthetic_flow_data.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

head(flow_data)
```

## 计算各分类轴上的堆叠位置

```{r layout-functions}
score_levels <- c("None", "Least", "Moderately", "Most", "Loss", "Heavily")

axis_definition <- list(
  list(
    name = "Country (ISO3)", variable = "country", x = 1,
    levels = c("GBR", "USA", "CHL", "FRA", "MEX", "ARG", "AUS", "NZL"),
    tie = c("lfp_category", "realm")
  ),
  list(
    name = "LFP Category", variable = "lfp_category", x = 2,
    levels = c("Highly", "Moderately", "Less", "None"),
    tie = c("realm", "country")
  ),
  list(
    name = "Realm", variable = "realm", x = 3,
    levels = c("Tropical Atlantic", "Temperate South America",
               "Temperate Northern Pacific", "Southern Ocean"),
    tie = c("lfp_category", "country")
  )
)

calculate_axis_positions <- function(data, definition) {
  positioned <- data
  positioned$stratum <- factor(
    positioned[[definition$variable]],
    levels = definition$levels
  )
  positioned$score_order <- factor(positioned$score, levels = score_levels)

  order_columns <- c("stratum", definition$tie, "score_order", "flow_id")
  order_arguments <- lapply(order_columns, function(column) positioned[[column]])
  positioned <- positioned[do.call(order, order_arguments), ]

  stratum_totals <- positioned |>
    group_by(stratum) |>
    summarise(total = sum(weight), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(stratum) |>
    mutate(base = cumsum(total) - total)

  positioned |>
    left_join(stratum_totals, by = "stratum") |>
    group_by(stratum) |>
    mutate(
      y_low = base + cumsum(weight) - weight,
      y_high = base + cumsum(weight)
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    transmute(
      flow_id,
      axis = definition$name,
      x = definition$x,
      stratum = as.character(stratum),
      y_low,
      y_high
    )
}

axis_positions <- bind_rows(lapply(axis_definition, function(definition) {
  calculate_axis_positions(flow_data, definition)
}))

stratum_boxes <- axis_positions |>
  group_by(axis, x, stratum) |>
  summarise(
    y_min = min(y_low),
    y_max = max(y_high),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    half_width = case_when(
      x == 3 ~ 0.28,
      TRUE ~ 0.14
    )
  )
```

## 构造平滑流带并绘图

```{r alluvial-plot}
make_ribbon_segment <- function(left_positions, right_positions,
                                left_edge, right_edge, segment_number) {
  joined <- left_positions |>
    select(flow_id, left_low = y_low, left_high = y_high) |>
    inner_join(
      right_positions |>
        select(flow_id, right_low = y_low, right_high = y_high),
      by = "flow_id"
    )

  ribbon_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(joined)), function(i) {
    t <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 45)
    eased <- 3 * t^2 - 2 * t^3
    x_values <- left_edge + (right_edge - left_edge) * t
    lower <- joined$left_low[i] + (joined$right_low[i] - joined$left_low[i]) * eased
    upper <- joined$left_high[i] + (joined$right_high[i] - joined$left_high[i]) * eased

    data.frame(
      flow_id = joined$flow_id[i],
      segment = segment_number,
      polygon_id = paste(joined$flow_id[i], segment_number, sep = "-"),
      x = c(x_values, rev(x_values)),
      y = c(lower, rev(upper))
    )
  })

  bind_rows(ribbon_list)
}

axis_1 <- filter(axis_positions, x == 1)
axis_2 <- filter(axis_positions, x == 2)
axis_3 <- filter(axis_positions, x == 3)

ribbons <- bind_rows(
  make_ribbon_segment(axis_1, axis_2, 1.14, 1.86, 1),
  make_ribbon_segment(axis_2, axis_3, 2.14, 2.72, 2)
) |>
  left_join(select(flow_data, flow_id, score), by = "flow_id")

palette_lfp <- c(
  None = "#D9D9D6",
  Least = "#C9252D",
  Moderately = "#6BAED6",
  Most = "#1F2A5A",
  Loss = "#E76F51",
  Heavily = "#2A788E"
)

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = ribbons,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = polygon_id, fill = score),
    colour = alpha("#222222", 0.52),
    linewidth = 0.16,
    alpha = 0.94
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = stratum_boxes,
    aes(xmin = x - half_width, xmax = x + half_width, ymin = y_min, ymax = y_max),
    fill = alpha("white", 0.93),
    colour = "#4A4A4A",
    linewidth = 0.42
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = stratum_boxes,
    aes(x = x, y = (y_min + y_max) / 2, label = stratum),
    size = 2.65,
    lineheight = 0.86,
    colour = "#222222"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = palette_lfp,
    breaks = score_levels,
    name = "LFP score"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
    labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 2, 3),
    labels = c("Country (ISO3)", "LFP Category", "Realm"),
    limits = c(0.72, 3.28),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Multistage Categorical Alluvial Plot",
    subtitle = "Synthetic country–LFP category–realm flows",
    y = "% Area with kelp",
    x = NULL,
    caption = "Synthetic data · reproducible seed: 1031"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "left",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(6.5, "mm"),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(5.0, "mm"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      face = "bold",
      size = 10,
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 8.5),
    axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "#606060", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.55),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "#555555"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 14)),
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.margin = margin(12, 16, 12, 12)
  )

p

ggsave(
  filename = "multistage_alluvial.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

## 输出文件

编译本文档会同时生成：

- `multistage_alluvial.html`：完整的 R Markdown 编译结果；
- `multistage_alluvial.png`：300 dpi 高清图；
- `synthetic_flow_data.csv`：由固定随机种子生成的模拟汇总数据。
